remarks:
Welcome to 288 Hamilton Ave — elevated new construction in the heart of the City of Tonawanda. This beautifully crafted 3-bedroom, 2-bath home delivers the style, comfort, and quality buyers are looking for in today’s new construction market.

Step inside to a thoughtfully designed interior featuring luxury vinyl flooring throughout the main living areas and a beautifully appointed kitchen showcasing quartz countertops and a modern, sophisticated aesthetic. The open and functional layout provides an inviting setting for everyday living and entertaining, while the spacious 2-car garage offers convenient parking and additional storage.

The possibilities continue downstairs with a full basement featuring impressive 9-foot ceilings, providing exceptional potential for future finished living space, a home gym, recreation room, office, or additional storage.

Beyond 288 Hamilton Ave, this exciting new development offers an exceptional opportunity to build brand-new construction from the ground up. With 17 total lots available and pricing starting at $499,000, buyers can explore available homesites and create a custom home that fits their lifestyle and preferences.

Experience the advantages of new construction, modern design, quality finishes, and the opportunity to make your next home truly your own — all in a convenient City of Tonawanda location. Homesites, floor plans, pricing, and customization opportunities available upon request.
